title: Phosphonate supported assembly of nanoscale lotus-leaf-shaped nonanuclear lanthanide clusters

synthesis.procedure: Hpmp·HCl (1 mmol) was added to 4 mL of 1 M Nd(ClO4)3 solution. The clear solution was magnetically stirred and warmed to about 60 °C, and 0.5 M aqueous NaOH was added dropwise until pH ≈ 6.2. The mixture was then stirred at room temperature for another 1 h; a small amount of light purple precipitate was filtered off. The filtrate was left undisturbed, and light purple parallelepiped crystals appeared after one and a half months.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: light purple precipitate filtered off; filtrate left undisturbed to give light purple parallelepiped crystals after one and a half months

properties.summary: Variable-temperature magnetic susceptibility of polycrystalline 1 (2–300 K, 1 kOe) gives a room-temperature μeff of 3.17 μB per Nd(III), slightly below the free-ion 4I9/2 value of 3.62 μB, decreasing continuously to 2.11 μB at 2 K, attributed to thermal depopulation of Stark sublevels.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same procedure as 1, replacing Nd(ClO4)3 with Pr(ClO4)3: Hpmp·HCl (1 mmol) was added to 4 mL of 1 M Pr(ClO4)3 solution, stirred and warmed to about 60 °C, pH adjusted to about 6.2 with 0.5 M aqueous NaOH, stirred 1 h at room temperature, precipitate filtered, and the filtrate left undisturbed to crystallize.
